projectDescription: A fast JavaScript library to highlight text, words, or regular expression matches on a browser page, with support for the CSS Custom Highlight API, shadow DOM, iframes, and cross-element matching.
keyFeatures: Highlight arbitrary text strings, arrays of terms, and regular expressions in the DOM
CSS Custom Highlight API support (StaticRange/Range objects via HighlightRegistry)
Block element boundary control to limit cross-element matches
Separate capturing groups highlighting with RegExp d flag
Nesting and overlapping range/group highlighting via wrapAllRanges
markLines option for line-number-based range highlighting
Diacritics, synonyms, wildcards, and ignore-joiner/punctuation options
jQuery plugin and vanilla JS builds, with TypeScript declarations
JSDOM compatibility for server-side/virtual DOM environments
Significant performance improvements over the original mark.js library
